200.description: Verified TaskRef and immutable revision link

403.description: Space or project catalog access denied

204.description: Project associated with space; repeated link is a no-op
Association removed; space and documents preserved

409.description: Original operation, mapping or revision conflict

403.description: Registered owner PAT with exact wiki write scope required

AdmissionValidity.description: Absolute Unix seconds from the original owner. Relays may only shorten this interval.

ConfirmedProjectSpaces.description: A versioned full-set link response from the canonical Tracker owner.

DeletionRequest.description:
The required inventory is operator-owned and must include unavailable owners.
A new registry version cannot change an already prepared operation's inventory.

HumanAdmissionWindowV1.description: Display freshness only; every resource request still needs its own owner proof.

OwnerFreezeReceipt.description:
A receipt means the owner committed a durable freeze before inspecting refs.
New references remain blocked until an explicit release or permanent tombstone.

OwnerReferenceSummary.description: A preliminary read is not a freeze and never authorizes finalization.

OwnerReleaseReceipt.description:
Release also persists cancellation when no freeze was observed. A delayed
freeze request for this operation must then be rejected by the owner.

ProjectLifecycle.description:
Independent Tracker-owned archive state. Space restoration never alters it.
Metadata only; this is not a write permit or a claim that a job has stopped.

oneOf.description: An explicit, immutable ID mapping for imported projects, never a name match.

expected_draft_checksum.description: Optional for legacy clients; official clients publish an exact saved draft.

ResourceContextSummary.description: Owner-local navigation metadata. Labels and keys are never used as identities.

oneOf.description: Wiki returns its persistent local UUID. Barrier-only participants have no local resource.

SpaceProjectsV2.description: A Space collection is read at its canonical Tracker owner, not guessed from a projection.

oneOf.description: A key URL resolves only when the dossier identity is unambiguous.

WorkspaceProject.description: Tracker presentation never grants access to the optional owner-local Wiki resource.

WorkspaceSpace.description: The same Wiki space can appear in several project collections without copies.
